cve.id: String. The canonical CVE identifier (e.g., CVE-2025-13473).
cve.url: String. Link to the official CVE record on cve.org.
cve.description: String. Technical description provided by the CVE numbering authority.
cve.published_at: String (ISO 8601). Timestamp of first publication by the CNA.
cve.updated_at: String (ISO 8601). Timestamp of the last metadata update by the CNA.

ghsa.id: String. The GitHub Security Advisory identifier (e.g., GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).
ghsa.url: String. Direct link to the advisory on GitHub.
ghsa.summary: String. Concise title of the vulnerability from GitHub.
ghsa.description: String (Markdown). Detailed impact and remediation description from community review.
ghsa.severity: String. Qualitative rating (Critical, High, Medium, Low).

cvss.vector: String. The CVSS vector string (e.g., CVSS:3.1/...).
cvss.severity: String. Severity rating associated with the score.

vulnerable_ranges.fixed_in: String. The first version that includes the fix.

ghsa.published_at: String (ISO 8601). Timestamp when published on GitHub.
ghsa.updated_at: String (ISO 8601). Timestamp of last review on GitHub.

cwe.name: String. Full name of the Common Weakness Enumeration category.

django.url: String. Link to the specific Django security release blog post.
django.description: String. The specific detailed text describing this issue from the Django release notes.

fixed_versions.version: String. The Django branch or tag name (e.g., Django 4.2).

patch.commit: String. The SHA-1 hash of the fix commit.
patch.url: String. Direct link to the commit on GitHub.

supported_python_versions: Array of Strings. Python versions supported by this Django release (e.g., ['3.10', '3.11', '3.12']).
fixed_versions.python_versions_source: String. The file used to determine the supported Python versions (e.g., 'git show 4.2:setup.cfg').

references: Array of Strings. Deduplicated list of all unique external URLs related to this CVE.
